messages:
maria (AE): Quick heads-up — AcmeCo POC kicks off Mon. They want a compact evidence bundle: SOC2 control excerpts (encryption at rest + access control), a signed pen-test acceptance/attestation letter we can share, staging IP range, and a presigned upload for logs. Can we assemble what’s safe to share?
anna (Sales-Eng): Copy. Do they need full SOC2 report or just the relevant control excerpts?
maria (AE): They asked for ‘excerpts’ but legal might request formal wording. Trying to avoid sending full report.
ben (Security): We can provide SOC2 excerpt PDF that redacts client-sensitive ops details. For pen-test letter we need Legal sign-off — it’s a short attestation: "Redwood Inference has engaged a 3rd-party penetration test on X date; findings remediated as of Y".
clare (Legal): I can draft a standard pen-test attestation. Need to confirm the test scope name and whether AcmeCo wants vendor signature or an admin-signed letter. Also check if they need non-disclosure text.
liam (Infra-Ops): Staging IPs: 54.210.32.0/24 and 34.120.100.128/26. If they want a maintenance window for an external scan, we need a date range.
maria (AE): They asked for a scan window next Tue-Fri 09:00–17:00 PST. Is that feasible?
liam (Infra-Ops): That window works, but external scans must be prescheduled. Also if they run authenticated tests we need a temporary service account & short-lived creds.
anna (Sales-Eng): For uploads, we use presigned S3 links. Default expiry is 1h. They asked for longer retention while their IR team ingests. Could we do 24h?
liam (Infra-Ops): 24h presign is fine but note our tooling uses expires_in=86400. If you need a sample CLI: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-proofpack/acmeco.zip --expires-in 86400`.
ben (Security): Also we should strip PII from any logs. I'll prepare a checklist of items that must be redacted: IPs of customers, usernames, auth tokens.
clare (Legal): Drafting pen-test attestation now. @maria — please confirm the vendor name and test completion date. Once I have that I'll sign and return a PDF.
maria (AE): Vendor is SecureWave Labs, completed 2025-02-10. Sending their summary via DM.
ops-bot: Reminder: create-presigned-link job queued (job id: 99321).
anna (Sales-Eng): Thx. One more pricing note: AcmeCo is asking if providing the SOC2 excerpt and attestation triggers any professional services fee or legal review charge. Sales: we should avoid surprise charges.
clare (Legal): No charge for standard attestation for active POCs. If they request contract-level changes or extra liability wording, that’s a billable legal review.
maria (AE): Got it. ETA for bundle? Need to share before EOD Friday.
ben (Security): I'll finish redaction checklist + excerpt by Thursday EOD.
clare (Legal): Pen-test attestation PDF ready by Friday morning for signature.
liam (Infra-Ops): Presigned link can be created Friday 09:00 PST and set to 24h. I'll also reserve scan window Tue–Fri next week.
anna (Sales-Eng): I'll assemble the folder in the dataroom: `acmeco/proofpack/` and add a SMALL readme explaining redactions and contact for questions.
maria (AE): Perfect — tagging folks: @ben, @clare, @liam — thanks team.
anna (Sales-Eng): One operational gotcha: some customers want the pen-test letter to include a line: "No known unremediated critical findings." Legal, can you include that if accurate?
clare (Legal): We can include that statement only if Security confirms there were no open criticals at sign-off. Ben?
ben (Security): Confirmed — no open criticals as of 2025-02-10.
maria (AE): Closing loop: I'll send AcmeCo the presigned link + excerpt + signed attestation Friday PM.
ops-bot: Job 99321 completed. Presign URL: https://presign.redwood.example/acmeco-proofpack-99321 (expires in 24h)
liam (Infra-Ops): Added staging IPs to the scan allowlist and documented the maintenance window.
clare (Legal): Signed attestation uploaded to dataroom.
ben (Security): SOC2 excerpt and redaction checklist uploaded.
maria (AE): Shared with AcmeCo ops team. Closing thread unless there are objections. :thumbsup:
